name: GetFileVersions
description: Retrieves the version history of a file in SharePoint using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The path of the file in SharePoint for which you want to retrieve version history. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFile.txt

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the file version retrieval operation, including the version history and any error messages.
